about: The persons-available block (panel_c_available) of results/power/power.json exactly as tools/fig_power.py generated it on 2026-09-24 10:33 (git 8d6a4f4), copied here on 2026-09-25 when Figure 5's rebuild (10:26; paper2_levelcheck/MOVED_FROM_PAPER1.md item 4) dropped the persons-available panels from power.json. The cover letter's COBRA screen calls (91; L6 38, T13 45), the seven at-risk persons with an exported frame and the three real C-ArmLSpine L6 patients are read from here by packet_src/build_packet_src.py (numbers.json). Each row's `tags` names the live source under results/ (fig6/frozen/v1/strata.json, transitional_registry/cobra/rows.csv, fig6/sets_v2/T2_persons.json, fig6/frozen/v1/split_final.json); the manuscript's own row is NUMBERS.md line 435. Verbatim copy; nothing recomputed.

ts_correction.what: The task names the TotalSegmentator correction as 'L6 109, T13 9': that is VERIDAH's ctd naming of the twelve re-read TotalSegmentator spines, over all persons of the subtype table (all sides, the three C-ArmLSpine L6 included). The table, the G3 split and the frozen strata carry the later independent rib count (SchwingNet/results/spineps_ids/TS12_VERIFY.md): two of VERIDAH's T13 are rib-less 20th vertebrae (L6 by the rib convention) and one of its L6 is a normal spine. Figure 5 draws G3 TEST persons only; TotalSegmentator contributes 2 L6 and 1 T13 to them.

screen_calls_under_0602_rule.rule: an L6 call with no L1 in its field, and a T13 call over L1-L4 only, not counted (split_plan.md)

carmlspine_real_L6.why: real G3 test persons, excluded from the primary analysis in advance (LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md sec. 4; the second labeller disagrees on every lumbar body, results/spineps_ids/VERIFY.md); reported descriptively
